comments.author: Blake.C
comments.body: Note: A couple of guides out there (such as the Taiwanese wiki) claim this has decent value in nanban, particularly in Japan. I tested this out in Japan and found this wasn't the case. Even with good backstock rates and using the Nanban Purveyor Certificates, I was only getting a 3:1 ratio.
